notes.title: 0.27.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663459/cf4b81bbd48b52e112a426f38af79315843e2f47.jpg"][/img]
Welcome to Early Access skate. fam![/p][p align="start"]The playtest forum will be archived (but still visible!), so go check out our new, public forums [url="https://forums.ea.com/category/skate-games-en/discussions/skate-en"]here[/url]. The team has tracked and squashed some bugs that popped up since 0.27.5 (our previous update that gave our skate. Insiders an Insider’s Preview to help iron out some bugs and issues). With the game launching in Early Access on Sept 16, 2025 (tomorrow, can you believe it?!), we’ll continue listening to the community and working to make the gameplay experience better.[/p][p align="start"]Speaking of the skate. Insider program, Insider Rewards will start rolling out this week for everyone who registered as a skate. Insider. You’ll need to check the account you signed up to playtest with to get the Insider deck and pack of Insider deck stickers. Thank you for joining us in the skate. insider program!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663459/72ca624bfa61bf4fb24b409970e454b9a5aee6ce.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]PROGRESSION UPDATE[/b][/p][p align="start"]Our Insider's Preview showed you guys cranking through the game, so the team has looked deeply into progression rates and made some changes to how fast you earn XP.[/p][p align="start"]To note:[/p][list][*][p]We’ve eliminated any per-drop XP[/p][/*][*][p]Removed XP gain from items acquired through Neighborhood rank up[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve streamlined all XP gamins from drop items to be 50 XP, regardless of rarity[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced XP gains in Market Mile mission item rewards[/p][/*][/list][p][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a few soft-lock progression issues, including the “Complete The Line” Mission[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some crashing issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with party invites for Throwdowns[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed performance issues related to Quick Dropping items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various localization and text issues throughout the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some thumbnail issues in the Create-A-Skater[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a flickering shadow in two cinematics[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few character gesture issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed for getting stuck under the map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the “Err” Notification[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed PC players unable to turn off friend request notifications[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where players are able to see other skaters when in spectate mode and can still hear them; however, in normal gameplay, they are invisible[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where if a party member leaves, the party behaves as if they are still joined[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Founder's Edition visual bug - Info Panel shows cross out pricing even if the player does not have EA Play[/p][/*][*][p]Some CDN Image resizes to improve performance on Gen 4 consoles, especially Xbox One[/p][/*][*][p]Various localization fixes[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Beyond the fixes coming in Early Access, we do have some Known Issues we’re hard at work on to get addressed and ready for Season 1, coming with Update 0.28.0 in a few weeks.[/p][list][*][p][b]The replay editor often captures stuttering during export.[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Our team is looking into this for a solution and will keep you posted with our progress.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Players can be trapped by drop items in shop spawn locations.[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Workaround:[/b] Change “Quick Drop Visibility” in your social settings to “Only Me”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Fixed with Update 0.28.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Unable to play Skate. due to a "connection to EA Servers" error. "ERROR 852146987"[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Troubleshooting:[/b] Make sure to disable VPN; check that the EA App is not in offline mode. For more troubleshooting help, check this [url="https://help.ea.com/en/articles/technical-issues/problems-connecting-online/"]Connectivity FAQ.[/url][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]The RIP Card customization will flicker between the old and new assets for a while after the selected user updates their customization.[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Fixed in 0.28[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Player stuck unable to progress Tour 1 Skater Eyes: Stunting 101[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Fixed in 0.28[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]During the last step of "Spots and How to Own Them" when the user will start the challenge, they will be stuck for ~3 minutes with the message "Waiting for players".[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Workaround:[/b] Wait for the timer to run out, challenge will then be able to be completed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Fixed in 0.28[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Quick Drops are invisible when chosen and cannot be placed[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Fixed in 0.28[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Sometimes viewing the preview of players in the San Van List causes a black screen, and exiting out to game from this state will lead to a soft lock[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Fixed in 0.28[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]When entering a grind and leaning to exit, skater disappears (rare)[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Fixed in 0.28[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Criteria for unlocking the Financial neighborhood is not showing up, causing the "Manual Extension" mission to not appear[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Workaround:[/b] You can get to the Financial Neighborhood (Market Mile) by doing more Challenges. Get that XP![/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Our team is looking into this for a solution.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Criteria for unlocking the Historic neighborhood (Gullcrest Village) is not showing up, causing the mission to not appear[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Workaround:[/b] You can get to the Historic neighborhood (Gullcrest Village) by doing more Challenges. Get that XP![/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Our team is looking into this for a solution.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Disabled the “Pad Hopper” Challenge due to a world prop making the Challenge harder than intended.[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Fixed in 0.28.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: skate. Early Access PC Specs & Requirements
notes.content:
skate. Early Access is coming to PC on Steam (that’s right, Steam Native, fam!) on September 16, 2025, and we’re stoked to officially have PC as a platform for the first time in the franchise’s history. Every PC is different, but there’s some baseline requirements you need to know to ensure you’re cruising around San Van on your gaming rig in the best way.

As a reminder, keyboard and mouse are not supported for Early Access. You will need a controller to play skate. on PC, such as PS4 DualShock, PS5 DualSense, Xbox One or Xbox Series X|S controller. The DualSense Edge and Xbox Elite V1/V2 are also compatible.

Let’s dive into the specs, from Low to Ultra.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663459/aab4a4b797714051608aa3ed96584c067929af59.jpg[/img]

Please note: 
[list]
[*] MacOS, Linux are not supported. 
[*] While skate. will be Steam Native, Steam Deck will not be supported.
[*] Full support for various upscaling technologies is in the works. There is currently some initial support in-game for FSR and XeSS, with more to come on DLSS in the future.
[/list]

notes.title: The Grind: Vol 3
notes.content:
[h3]Originally posted June 17th 2025[/h3][p][/p][p]Welcome back to The Grind! We’ve got Volume 3 comin’ in hot with a lot of info - especially about the upcoming Playtest update 0.27.0 dropping early July. Thanks to everyone for reading last month’s [url="https://www.ea.com/games/skate/news/the-grind-vol-two"][b]The Grind: Vol 2[/b][/url] and for submitting questions to the dev team via Discord. Don’t forget to [url="https://discord.gg/skateEA"][b]join the official Discord[/b][/url] to get your questions into the next edition! [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve got a big one today, so buckle up. [b]Coming July 2, 2025, we’ll be dropping our BIGGEST playtest update. [/b][/p][p][/p][p]First things first, as mentioned in [url="https://www.ea.com/games/skate/news/the-grind-vol-one"][b]The Grind: Vol 1[/b][/url], we will be sending out invites for 0.27 in waves starting soon to [i]everyone[/i] who has signed up as a skate. Insider. However, [b]we are closing skate. Insider registration on June 27, 2025. If you are signed up as an Insider before June 27 you will be invited in waves to the next playtest! [url="https://www.ea.com/games/skate/insider-playtest-registration"]If you haven’t signed up, do it now[/url]![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Don’t forget to ensure that your gaming account is the one you sign up with so you get the skate. Insider Rewards when we launch Early Access, and if you need help linking your console, check this [url="https://help.ea.com/en/help/account/link-your-console-accounts/"][b]FAQ[/b][/url].[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663459/72ca624bfa61bf4fb24b409970e454b9a5aee6ce.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]WISHLISTS ARE LIVE![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re also excited to announce that you can now wishlist skate. on various platforms, including PlayStation, Xbox, Steam, and the Epic Game Store, right [url="https://ea.com/games/skate/skate"]here[/url]. So if you want to throw a little support at skate.’s launch and get a reminder when Early Access goes live – head over and Wishlist skate. today![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Update 0.27.0[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]With update 0.27.0 we’re stoked to bring some major improvements to the playtest, much of which is based on your playtesting feedback. Find out more info below and we can’t wait for you to jump in.[/p][p][/p][p]But first, let’s just take a look at what 0.27 will look like. We think you’re going to notice a big difference.[/p][p][/p][p]We stole this collection of clips from our team playing an early build of .27 so you could get a sneak peek of what’s to come. This is pre-release, but enjoy![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="CA3z4t8iMRU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]What’s happening with the skate. Insider Playtest?[/b][/p][p]Update 0.27 is packed with upgrades, changes, fixes, and performance improvements that you’ve been highlighting in feedback and asking for in forums. We’re stoked to give you a preview of what’s coming (we’ll have full patch notes for our playtesters before the update drops). Thanks again to everyone in the community who has helped shape this updated build![/p][list][*][p][b]You Said: When are the visuals being updated?[/b] In Update 0.27, we have improved the visuals and you’ll notice the difference immediately (see the video above to get a sneak peek!) The city is more alive than it’s ever been! [/p][list][*][p]You’ll find a ton more detail, like environmental content, signage, foliage, and graffiti as well as increased pedestrian and traffic activity, with more than [i]3X the number of pedestrians and around 5X the number of vehicles[/i]. [/p][/*][*][p]On the technical side, there is improved lighting and shadows, updated textures and effects, and other fine detail throughout San Vansterdam. [/p][/*][*][p]The UI has presentation improvements throughout the game, including visual updates with animations, video effects, and sound effects. Also, the Map has been improved to show other players.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve also upped the max number of players in a server to 150 while improving performance across platforms. And we’re going to keep on working on this through live service.   [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]You Said: We want more to do — give us more Missions and Challenges! [/b]More Missions, more Challenges. There is more to do in San Vansterdam, and we’ve also unlocked the Market Mile neighborhood![/p][list][*][p]We’ve streamlined and improved the opening/tutorial for the game to get you to San Vansterdam where we’ve added content, [i]more than tripling the number of missions available in the game![/i][/p][/*][*][p]You said you wanted even more Challenges, and now there are [i]more than 140 Challenges[/i] for you to conquer. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]You Said: Improve the feel of Progression & Rewards:[/b] This captures a lot of your feedback, but to put it simply, we’ve overhauled progression and rewards.[/p][list][*][p]As we mentioned above, the early tutorial experience has been streamlined to get into San Van much sooner. [/p][/*][*][p]Based on your feedback, we’ve also revamped how you progress by removing Collection Score as a gate for Challenge progression.[/p][/*][*][p]And when you move up, you want to really feel it, and that should be fun. So we now have bigger and better celebrations when you earn a reward, and we’ve revamped the earnable in-game Product Boxes - more boxes with better rewards. Let us know what you think when you get into 0.27. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]You Said: We love our characters — give us more customization:[/b] [i]skate[/i]. is all about you, an individual skateboarder finding and developing your own style, discovering your own spots, and expressing yourself, just like IRL. You’re not playing as anyone but who [i]you [/i]want to be in the game. So we heard this loud and clear, and we agreed. In Update 0.27, we’ve made big changes, and you’ll find new and improved character options, including more options for your character’s overall appearance, as well as additional hairstyles, gestures, and emotes, with even more to come down the line.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve made a lot more changes in Update 0.27, including updates to music and sound, the Replay Editor, general Quality of Life improvements, haptics and more.[/p][/*][/list][p]None of this would be possible without all of our playtesters telling us what you love, what you want more of, and what you'd like improved. The entire team is listening, and we will continue to work with you to grow, evolve, and improve skate. when we launch Early Access later this year and throughout the Early Access period. [/p][p]Check out these two side-by-side pics of the Canal and Financial Districts. With Update 0.27, we've improved lighting, added more textures, and there's more to come![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663459/1a0927f14518178226a792f427947195398ceccd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663459/3fe4e2efe8375665b41f1db97663caa84d7d9084.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Let’s dive in to your questions. Keep them coming![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Your Q’s, our A’s. [/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]When is skate. launching in Early Access?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Early Access is coming at the end of summer 2025 (Northern Hemisphere!). Yes, just months away now. And as a reminder, everyone who signs up as a [url="https://www.ea.com/games/skate/insider-playtest-registration"][b]skate. Insider[/b][/url] by June 27 will get invited to playtest before Early Access launch.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What kind of visual updates and improvements can we expect for skate. for Early Access?[/b][/p][list][*][p]We talked in detail above, but you'll notice visual improvements across a wide range of areas in Update (0.27) on July 2.

But know that San Van is always changing and skate. will never stop improving—its appearance will continuously evolve, unveiling new skateboarding spots and interesting details to discover. Early Access launch is just the beginning, and the city will keep evolving.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Will skate. support KBM (keyboard and mouse) controls?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Flick-It has always been the Skate franchise’s core control system: a reactive, dynamic, and immersive experience that has made Skate games [i]feel [/i]amazing and unique. For now, we’re sticking with the controls that you have loved for decades, and honestly, KBM simply doesn’t create the same tangible skateboarding feeling. So for now, you’ll need to use a controller on PC. We’re not entirely writing off KBM – we’re always listening to feedback. So let us know your thoughts on our controller-only approach.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]If I unlock something on my PC account, will I be able to use it on my Xbox/PS?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Absolutely! As long as your console account is [url="https://help.ea.com/en/help/account/link-your-console-accounts/"][b]linked to the PC account you play with[/b][/url][url="https://help.ea.com/en/help/account/link-your-console-accounts/"],[/url] any cosmetics or SVB you purchase on one platform will be available on every platform linked to that account.   [/p][/*][/list][p][b]What modes will be available? S.K.A.T.E., Death Races, Hall of Meat, OTS?[/b][/p][list][*][p]We'll continue to expand our gameplay modes and tricks as Early Access progresses (and beyond), and we’ll share more details about this when we have them.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Are there achievements/trophies in-game to earn?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Yes, with update 0.27 we’ve added 1st party Achievements/Trophies support for Early Access. (They're not live in this build, but we know you Achievement/Trophy hunters were wondering about them.)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Is there fast travel in San Vansterdam?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Getting to where you want to throw down quickly is key, so we have the San Van Transit system (it’s a bus). You can take the bus to various locations in the city, but you’ll have to level up your neighborhoods to unlock all the stops. You can also teleport to friends or other skaters you want to spectate.[/p][/*][/list][p]Don’t forget to drop your questions in the [url="https://discord.com/channels/771078623430967317/1331689579920625796"][b]Q &A[/b][/url] channel in The Grind category of the Discord, and we’ll pull some to answer for our next volume of The Grind. Join the community at [url="https://discord.gg/skateEA"][b]https://discord.gg/skateEA[/b][/url].[/p][p] [/p][p]See you in San Vansterdam,[/p][p]The skate. Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354750/skate/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The Grind: Vol 2
notes.content:
[h3][u]Originally posted May 22nd 2025[/u][/h3][p][/p][p]Welcome back to The Grind! Thanks to everyone for reading last month’s [b][url="https://www.ea.com/games/skate/news/the-grind-vol-one"]The Grind: Vol 1[/url][/b] and for submitting questions to the dev team via Discord. Don’t forget to [b][url="https://discord.gg/skateEA"]join the official Discord[/url][/b] to get your questions into the next edition! For Vol 2, we’ve grabbed[i] [/i]some of your recent questions as well as some of your long-standing questions and answered them below.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s happening with the skate. Insider Playtest?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]At the end of April, we re-launched the skate. Mobile Playtest for iOS and Android devices as a technical test to determine the stability on a range of devices. [/p][p][/p][p]On console and PC, the team is working towards update 0.27.0 that will bring bug fixes, new features, more content, and other key improvements. We’re also working on our in-game reporting processes to protect against griefing or inappropriate content.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll talk in more detail about Update 0.27.0 in The Grind Vol 3 next month, so stay tuned and get your questions in. Reminder, our next big push of Playtesting invites will happen in late June, so keep an eye on your email inbox.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663459/007d43264e797ed45415a7cbaa75f7492fb5128a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Let’s dive in.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Your Q’s, our A’s. [/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Will Early Access be on Steam?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Yes, [i]skate[/i]. will be launching in Early Access on PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S/X, and PC (EA App, Steam, and Epic Game Store) in 2025. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]What are the plans for Create A Park/Player Parks?[/b][/p][list][*][p]We hear you! Player Parks are one of the most asked about features, and it’s something we will bring to San Vansterdam as the game evolves through Early Access.

In the meantime, we will have Community Parks throughout San Vansterdam that will evolve and change with each Season to keep things fresh. And with the Quick Drops, you have the ability to add items like ramps, railings, benches and more into the game world in real-time, so you can make any spot in San Vansterdam truly your own.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Is there a server browser for online lobbies?[/b][/p][list][*][p]We want San Vansterdam to be a living city, where you can hang out with new and old friends. To keep things easy, you won’t have to go through a server browser, you can just login and skate right away. If you want to skate with friends, you can find them in the friends list and join them directly on their server. We’ll continue to expand our social features throughout live service. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Will there be leaderboards like in Skate 3?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Everyone loved celebrating the stats of your skateboard feats (and failures) in [i]Skate[/i] [i]3[/i], and this is definitely something we want in [i]skate[/i]. It’s already on our development roadmap (no deploy date yet!), and we expect it to launch after our Early Access launch.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Will there be dual stick controls like Skater XL & Session?[/b][/p][list][*][p]One of the things that defines skate is the Flick-It system. It’s core to the DNA of the franchise and a big reason why we are all here. Gameplay is king and nothing is prioritized above making skateboarding feel amazing. So we’re keeping Flick-It as the standard for skate. – and making some improvements to the way it plays and feels. In addition, we’ve added additional control options for more Streamlined (for beginners) or Experienced (for experts) gameplay. In your Gameplay settings, you’ll be able to tweak and fine-tune your experience through settings for Auto Curb Pop or Vert Pump Assist, Grind Assist slider, and many more.   [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Will there be an equivalent to the Super Ultra Mega Park or the Skate 1/2 Mega Park in the new Skate game?[/b][/p][list][*][p]The team is working on exciting ways to bring “bigger” and crazier things to the game in special areas, but we’re not quite ready to talk about them in detail. We can’t wait to tell you more. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]How will you expand/update the city? [/b][/p][list][*][p]The city will change and evolve with noticeable additions and alterations coming on a regular basis. With regular updates, you’re going to discover all kinds of new places to skate. Some in unusual places. And, as a reminder, new areas of San Vansterdam will always be free and available to all players. We won’t be gating new gameplay locations behind paywalls. If it’s there, you can go there.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Will there be enough customization options when you start to create your skater or will we have to wait until we progress challenges or spend money?[/b][/p][list][*][p]When you drop in to [i]skate[/i]. you’ll immediately customize the way your skater looks. [i]skate[/i]. is all about you, the skater, so we’re giving you the freedom to change things like body type, face details, hair, and more. Once we launch in Early Access, we plan to expand customization options over time so you never have to stop evolving your skater.

We will always have options available to customize your skater further, including through cosmetics like clothing and accessories by earning currency and rewards through in-game play without having to spend money.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663459/e53959039a8602a7229832a925a5f982faaf152e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Don’t forget to drop your questions in the Q &A channel in The Grind category of the Discord, and we’ll pull some to answer for our next volume of The Grind. Join the community at [b][url="https://discord.gg/skateEA"]https://discord.gg/skateEA[/url][/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]See you in San Vansterdam,[/p][p]The skate. Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354750/skate/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The Grind: Vol 1
notes.content:
[h3][u]Originally posted April 24th, 2025[/u][/h3][p][/p][p]Welcome to The Grind! What is The Grind? This is our platform to talk directly to you, the community. We will share details about skate., answering your questions directly, and talk about where we’re at in development (from playtesting onward). We want The Grind to tell you everything you need to know about skate. before we open up San Vansterdam in Early Access later this year. 

The Grind is about you, our players, and for it to work, we need your questions. We are opening a new question submission form in the official Discord and we’ll pull questions from there for our next volume of The Grind, coming in May.

Join the community at [b][url="https://discord.gg/skateEA"]https://discord.gg/skateEA[/url][/b] and start adding your questions for the development team. And please – don’t hold back. Ask the questions that you really want answers to. 

Let’s get Vol 1 of [i]The Grind[/i] rolling![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663459/43011cdcbcb842203672eee235f95aa5502ddbf0.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]What’s happening with the skate. Insider Playtest?[/h3][p][/p][p]In Sept 2024, we began our Always-On Playtest. This new phase tests the game in a permanent live environment, with servers running around the clock. We began with PC and mobile testing and rolled out a small wave of console test invites.[/p][p][/p][p]In March, we invited our biggest wave of testers to date, launched the 0.26.0 playtest update, and turned on virtual currency testing for PS and PC testers. We’ve updated the city, added more challenges, updated visuals, fixed bugs from 0.25.0, and much more.[/p][p][/p][p]As skate. Insiders share their feedback and issues, the Full Circle team is working to address these reports and continually improve the gameplay and the feel of skating in San Vansterdam. We're building this game in collaboration with the community, and that’s why these playtests and the sharing of bugs, issues, and feedback is so important.[/p][p][/p][p]To date, we’ve invited more than 200K players into the playtest, and that massive amount of feedback (over 30K posts on the playtest forums and over 20K survey responses) has helped steer the direction of skate. and improve the gameplay and performance. So thank you, testers, for all that you’ve done so far and continue to do. And if you’re reading this and still waiting for an invite, don’t worry, we’re planning on sending out another large wave of invites in June.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663459/58a4c583d92935a41903c8dd327d3b251b05318d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Just for fun, we asked our data team to share some of the things you’ve all been doing in the playtest. Check out some of the highlights of your accomplishments in San Vansterdam: [/p][list][*][p]More than 16 million kickflips* [/p][/*][*][p]More than 4.8 million 50-50 Grinds landed - nothin’ but bolts![/p][/*][*][p]The Longest Grind (so far) – more than 200 meters! That’s about 15 school buses! [/p][/*][*][p]More than 40 million Total Wipeouts – Ouch![/p][/*][*][p]More than 6.5 million Challenges completed [/p][/*][/list][p][i]*includes varial and nollie kickflips[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Now, let’s answer some of those questions you’ve asked us that need answers![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Your Q’s, our A’s. [/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Is skate. still launching in 2025?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Yes! We are still planning on launching in Early Access later this year. We have an ambitious vision for skate.: an ever-growing, ever-evolving skateboarding sandbox that expands over time with the feedback of the players living in San Vansterdam. Our Early Access launch will only be [i]Day One[/i] of that experience, a starting point from which new features, improvements, and content will be added over time.

We don’t consider the Early Access launch the “finished version” of skate., and neither should you. But the skateboarding experience will be great, and you’ll have tons to do with your friends in San Vansterdam.

We can’t wait to share more details about what we have planned, both for day one of Early Access and in the months that follow. We’ll be updating you regularly over the next few months so keep an eye out right here and on our official social channels to stay up to date.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Will skate. have an offline mode?[/b][/p][list][*][p]The simple answer: No. The game and city are designed to be a living, breathing massively multiplayer skateboarding sandbox that is always online and always evolving. You’ll see bigger things evolve, like changes to the city over time, as well as smaller things, like live events and other in-game activities. In order to deliver on our vision of a skateboarding world, the game will always require a live connection. That is probably not much of a surprise if you’ve been in our playtest.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]How did you come up with the name San Vansterdam?[/b][/p][list][*][p]We TOTALLY conducted extensive scientific, data-driven research and didn’t just spitball names until we found something everyone didn't hate. We promise. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Is cross-play/cross-progression in the playtest? [/b][/p][list][*][p]Absolutely! When you load in, you can see if someone is on a console or PC with cross-play on by default. And with cross-progression, if you have access to more than one platform for playtesting, you can literally log out of one platform, and launch skate. on the other platform, and you’ll start exactly where you logged out.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hey, I signed up but never got in. What gives?[/b][/p][list][*][p]It’s nothing personal, we promise! To make our testing most effective and to ensure stability, we are providing access to testers in waves. But rest assured, before we launch into Early Access, everyone who has registered as skate. Insiders will get an invite to come playtest the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Why are microtransactions active in the playtest?[/b][/p][list][*][p]San Vansterdam will be a living skating world and we want to support ongoing development effectively while also offering a system that feels fair and fun for all of our players.

To get there, we’re running extensive testing across PC and PS (Xbox testing will be rolling out later) to catch any issues or pain points, and to ensure that the content represents a fair value for our players.

We know that using real money during a playtest is a little unusual, but we think it’s the best way to properly assess and adjust the system before launch. If you see prices or other things changing over time, please understand that this is normal. And of course, you will receive the amount you spent during playtesting in San Van Bucks (SVB) when we reset for Early Access launch.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What happens with any money I spend during the Playtest?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Like we said, if you choose to participate in this test and spend real money, whatever you spend will be returned to you in SVB when the game launches for Early Access. If you buy $20 of SVB, you will enter Early Access with $20 worth of SVB waiting for you on the same EA account.

While it’s important to us for testing, we understand some of you may feel uncomfortable spending real money in a test-phase game. So if you don’t want to spend your money right now, we totally get it, and your feedback is always important to us. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Is everything “cool” going to be locked behind a paywall?[/b][/p][list][*][p]We are still adjusting the in-game rewards system, including the items available with San Van Bucks and the earnable Rip Chips currency, which will allow you to grab items from Product Boxes by completing Challenges and ranking up the districts of San Vansterdam. As mentioned in [b][url="https://www.ea.com/games/skate/news/the-board-room-episode-03"]The Board Room Ep 3[/url][/b], skate. will not have paid lootboxes. The bottom line – there will be “cool” things for you to earn and customize your character [i]without [/i]having to spend real cash.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Will there be locations on the map that will cost money?[/b][/p][list][*][p]The city of San Vansterdam will grow and evolve, with new areas opening up over its lifetime. As we said in one of our first Board Room videos, we will not lock new gameplay areas behind a paywall. If a new area is added to the game world, you can access it for free.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Will I have to pay to level up the stats of my character?[/b][/p][list][*][p]skate. isn’t a pay-to-win game, so there will be no paying to increase your skater’s skills (there also are no skill stats to increase for your skater anyway). Your stats are in your fingers - how good you Flick-it is how good you are in San Vansterdam.
